Line 53 has a clear bug: the loop checks `input.slot` instead of `slot`, so only the first week is ever checked for conflicts. That is visible in the diff, so no further file reads were needed.

The test `test_one_taken_week_books_nothing` doesn't catch this. It pre-books SEVEN, which is the first slot, so the check on `input.slot` happens to find it. If a later week is taken and the first is free, the command saves overlapping bookings. It may also overwrite the existing booking, depending on how `save` behaves.

Separately, the error message on line 54 uses `slot.day`, which is the right week. That makes the message and the check disagree about which slot is being examined.
